title: When the Colony Burns
author: Rafael Vane
blurb: Sebastian Montrose, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
